content:
# Product-only consumer for the `velnor-workflow` CI runtime. This action
# NEVER compiles: it resolves the immutable product for a generator revision
# and downloads it.
#
# Resolution: `rev` (a generator commit) -> source-closure digest. The closure
# is the canonical `git ls-tree` bytes of the closure inputs plus the footer
# (see `crates/velnor-workflow/src/closure.rs`): computed from the local
# checkout when it contains the revision, else via the repository trees API
# over the same canonical bytes. Two commits with the same closure name the
# same product.
#
# Acquisition: the immutable release `velnor-workflow-runtime-v1-<digest16>`
# in the product repository. The tag is a locator only; every byte is proven:
# the manifest binds closure/revision/platform, the binary SHA-256 is
# recomputed, the binary's own `--closure` report must match the resolved
# closure and its `--revision` report must match the manifest revision, and
# the asset and manifest attestations must verify against the pinned
# producer workflow and default-branch ref.
#
# The Actions cache is a pure acceleration: the per-closure directory is
# re-verified on every restore, and a cold cache costs one small download,
# never a compilation.
#
# A revision with no published product fails closed and names the producer
# (the mainline runtime-product publisher). Publication belongs to the
# producer; consumers never build.
name: Set up Velnor workflow runtime
description: Acquire the prebuilt velnor-workflow product for a generator revision

inputs:
  rev:
    description: Generator commit whose runtime product to acquire
    required: true
  checkout-path:
    description: Checkout holding generator history for closure resolution
    required: false
    default: ${{ github.workspace }}
  cache:
    description: Cache the product with GitHub cache
    required: false
    default: 'true'
  cache-key-prefix:
    description: Prefix for the product cache key
    required: false
    default: velnor-workflow-v3
  github-token:
    description: GitHub token for API and release access
    required: false
    default: ${{ github.token }}

outputs:
  closure:
    description: Source-closure digest the acquired product was resolved from
    value: ${{ steps.closure.outputs.value }}

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Resolve source closure
      id: closure
      shell: bash
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github-token }}
        INSTALL_REV: ${{ inputs.rev }}
        CHECKOUT_PATH: ${{ inputs.checkout-path }}
        PRODUCT_REPOSITORY: tailrocks/velnor
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        sha256_digest() {
          if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'
          elif command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}'
          else
            echo "::error::no SHA-256 checksum tool available (sha256sum or shasum)" >&2
            return 1
          fi
        }
        test "$INSTALL_REV" != '' || { echo "::error::runtime revision is empty" >&2; exit 1; }
        [[ "$INSTALL_REV" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo "::error::runtime revision must be a full commit SHA, got $INSTALL_REV" >&2; exit 1; }
        listing=""
        if git -C "$CHECKOUT_PATH" cat-file -e "$INSTALL_REV^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
          listing="$(git -C "$CHECKOUT_PATH" ls-tree -r "$INSTALL_REV" -- crates/velnor-workflow Cargo.toml Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml rust-toolchain .cargo)"
        else
          tree="$(gh api "repos/$PRODUCT_REPOSITORY/git/trees/$INSTALL_REV?recursive=1")" || { echo "::error::unknown generator revision $INSTALL_REV" >&2; exit 1; }
          [[ "$(jq -r '.truncated // false' <<<"$tree")" != "true" ]] || { echo "::error::tree API response is truncated; the closure cannot be proven" >&2; exit 1; }
          listing="$(jq -r '[.tree[] | select(.type != "tree") | select(.path == "Cargo.toml" or .path == "Cargo.lock" or .path == "rust-toolchain.toml" or .path == "rust-toolchain" or (.path | startswith("crates/velnor-workflow/")) or (.path | startswith(".cargo/"))) | "\(.mode) \(.type) \(.sha)\t\(.path)"] | sort | join("\n")' <<<"$tree")"
        fi
        test "$listing" != '' || { echo "::error::revision $INSTALL_REV has no closure inputs" >&2; exit 1; }
        closure="$(printf '%s\nclosure-version:1\nfeatures:\nprofile:release\n' "$(LC_ALL=C sort <<<"$listing")" | sha256_digest)"
        [[ "$closure" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { echo "::error::closure resolution failed" >&2; exit 1; }
        echo "value=$closure" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    - name: Restore runtime cache
      id: cache
      if: inputs.cache == 'true'
      uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/velnor/workflow-runtime
        key: ${{ inputs.cache-key-prefix }}-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ steps.closure.outputs.value }}

    - name: Download runtime product
      if: steps.cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      shell: bash
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github-token }}
        INSTALL_REV: ${{ inputs.rev }}
        CLOSURE: ${{ steps.closure.outputs.value }}
        PRODUCT_REPOSITORY: tailrocks/velnor
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        for tool in gh jq; do
          command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "::error::required tool missing: $tool" >&2; exit 1; }
        done
        tag="velnor-workflow-runtime-v1-${CLOSURE:0:16}"
        asset="velnor-workflow-${RUNNER_OS}-${RUNNER_ARCH}"
        temporary="$(mktemp -d)"
        trap 'rm -rf "$temporary"' EXIT
        if ! gh release download "$tag" --repo "$PRODUCT_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$asset" --pattern manifest.json --dir "$temporary"; then
          echo "::error::no runtime product for revision $INSTALL_REV (closure ${CLOSURE:0:16}); the mainline runtime-product publisher builds it after merge" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
        gh attestation verify "$temporary/$asset" \
          --owner tailrocks \
          --signer-workflow tailrocks/velnor/.github/workflows/ci-runtime-products.yml \
          --source-ref refs/heads/main
        gh attestation verify "$temporary/manifest.json" \
          --owner tailrocks \
          --signer-workflow tailrocks/velnor/.github/workflows/ci-runtime-products.yml \
          --source-ref refs/heads/main
        jq -e \
          --arg closure "$CLOSURE" \
          --arg platform "${RUNNER_OS}-${RUNNER_ARCH}" \
          --arg asset "$asset" \
          '.closure == $closure and (.revision | test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$")) and .profile == "release" and .features == "" and (.products[$platform].binary | test("^[0-9a-f]{64}$")) and .products[$platform].asset == $asset' \
          "$temporary/manifest.json" >/dev/null
        if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          actual="$(sha256sum "$temporary/$asset" | awk '{print $1}')"
        else
          actual="$(shasum -a 256 "$temporary/$asset" | awk '{print $1}')"
        fi
        expected="$(jq -er --arg platform "${RUNNER_OS}-${RUNNER_ARCH}" '.products[$platform].binary' "$temporary/manifest.json")"
        [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || { echo "::error::runtime digest mismatch" >&2; exit 1; }
        runtime="$HOME/.cache/velnor/workflow-runtime/$CLOSURE"
        mkdir -p "$runtime/bin"
        cp "$temporary/$asset" "$runtime/bin/velnor-workflow"
        chmod 0755 "$runtime/bin/velnor-workflow"
        cp "$temporary/manifest.json" "$runtime/manifest.json"
        chmod 0644 "$runtime/manifest.json"

    - name: Verify runtime product
      shell: bash
      env:
        CLOSURE: ${{ steps.closure.outputs.value }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        runtime="$HOME/.cache/velnor/workflow-runtime/$CLOSURE"
        jq -e \
          --arg closure "$CLOSURE" \
          --arg platform "${RUNNER_OS}-${RUNNER_ARCH}" \
          '.closure == $closure and (.revision | test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$")) and .profile == "release" and .features == "" and (.products[$platform].binary | test("^[0-9a-f]{64}$"))' \
          "$runtime/manifest.json" >/dev/null
        if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          actual="$(sha256sum "$runtime/bin/velnor-workflow" | awk '{print $1}')"
        else
          actual="$(shasum -a 256 "$runtime/bin/velnor-workflow" | awk '{print $1}')"
        fi
        expected="$(jq -er --arg platform "${RUNNER_OS}-${RUNNER_ARCH}" '.products[$platform].binary' "$runtime/manifest.json")"
        [[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || { echo "::error::cached runtime digest mismatch" >&2; exit 1; }

    - name: Add runtime to PATH
      shell: bash
      env:
        CLOSURE: ${{ steps.closure.outputs.value }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        runtime="$HOME/.cache/velnor/workflow-runtime/$CLOSURE"
        test -x "$runtime/bin/velnor-workflow"
        test -s "$runtime/manifest.json"
        reported="$("$runtime/bin/velnor-workflow" --closure)"
        [[ "$reported" == "$CLOSURE" ]] || { echo "::error::runtime at $runtime reports closure $reported, expected $CLOSURE" >&2; exit 1; }
        manifest_revision="$(jq -er '.revision' "$runtime/manifest.json")"
        reported_revision="$("$runtime/bin/velnor-workflow" --revision)"
        [[ "$reported_revision" == "$manifest_revision" ]] || { echo "::error::runtime at $runtime reports revision $reported_revision, expected $manifest_revision" >&2; exit 1; }
        echo "$runtime/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

    - name: Save runtime cache
      if: inputs.cache == 'true' && steps.cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' && ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)) || github.event_name == 'schedule' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)))
      uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/velnor/workflow-runtime
        key: ${{ inputs.cache-key-prefix }}-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ steps.closure.outputs.value }}
